SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Æth.]
Tearing, rending pains in pit of stomach, extending to œsophagus.
Pain in pit of stomach and abdomen, followed by nausea, with or without vomiting.
Cramp in stomach. θ Megrim.
Painful contractions of stomach so severe as to prevent vomiting. θ Cholerine.
Sense of pungent heat in stomach.
Complaints with cramp in stomach and cries and anguish.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Æth.]
Painfulness of epigastric region, nausea.
Stitches in epigastrium.
Lancinating in right hypochondrium, in afternoon.
Painful pressing, with burning and stitching in left hypochondrium.
Shooting in left hypochondrium, often and long continued.
Soreness and painfulness in both hypochondria.
Liver hard, yellowish, spleen livid, tongue black ; t.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Æth.]
Excessive griping pains in belly.
Colic, with diarrhœa.
Excessive griping pain in abdomen.
Colic, followed by vomiting, vertigo and weakness.
Cutting and violent vomiting.
Cutting, with distension of abdomen.
Contracted and tense abdomen.
Abdomen puffed sensitive to touch ; convulsions of children. θ Gastroenteritis.
Violent colic, followed by death of the boy.
Abdomen distended, with tension ; t.
Sensation of coldness in abdomen.
Coldness of abdomen and lower limbs, especially left one, with aching of bowels ; > by warm, wet applications.
Black bluish swelling of abdomen.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Æth.]
Loose stools, preceded by cutting in abdomen, with tenesmus in morning, after rising.
A thin stool finishes headache. θ Megrim.
Stools of partly digested food, shortly after a meal or at night.
Diarrhœa ; discharges green, thin, bilious, with violent tenesmus before and after stool. θ Convulsions of children. θ Gastroenteritis.
Bright yellow or greenish, watery, slimy stools ; crying, drawing up feet. Child, æt. 6 months.
Evacuations of a thin, bright yellow or greenish fluid, mixed with much bile, with severe tenesmus.
Greyish-green fluid stools. θ Cholerine.
Bloody stools.
With stools, painful contraction in stomach. θ Cholerine.
Most obstinate constipation, with feeling as if all action of bowels had been lost.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Æth.]
Pain in kidneys, < from sneezing, deep inhalation and lying down.
Cutting pains in bladder, with frequent calls to urinate.
Urine : red, sediment white ; copious, clear as water ; too frequent after exertion.
Nocturnal enuresis, with vomiting of coagulated milk after sucking bottle ; greenish watery diarrhœa.
No urine. θ Cholerine.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Æth.]
Right testicle drawn up, with pain in kidneys.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Æth.]
Checked catamenia.
Menses checked by a warm bath. θ Headache.
Menses watery.
Lancinating pains in sexual organs.
Pimples on external parts, itching when patient becomes warm.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Æth.]
Labor-pains : too weak ; not regular.
Violent stinging pain in mamma ; t.
Intolerance of milk ; child by a sudden and violent effort throws it up, curdled or not ; then weakness makes it drowsy for some minutes.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Æth.]
No voice. θ Cholerine.
The sufferings seem to render him speechless.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Æth.]
Short breath, interrupted by hiccough.
Short, anxious, whistling breathing, while lying on back.
Great dyspnœa ; t.
   

COUGH. [27] [Æth.]
Cough, with stunning pain in head.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Æth.]
Stitches in left side of chest.
Sensation as if chest was in a vise, with difficult breathing.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Æth.]
Anxiety in precordia ; t.
Violent palpitation of heart.
Palpitation : with headache ; with vertigo ; with weariness and exaltation ; t.
Pulse frequent, small, some what hard and unrhythmical.
Pulse full, rapid.
Weak intermittent pulse, with palpitation and headache.
Pulse feeble, sometimes not to be felt, much exhausted. θ Cholerine.
Slow strong beats of heart, stupor and death (dog).
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Æth.]
Distressing pain in occiput and nape of neck, extending down spine, > by friction with hot whiskey.
Lymphatic ganglions of neck swollen, like beads.
Sensation as if small of back was in a vise.
Painful furuncle in sacral region.
A feeling as if pain in back would be > by straightening out and bending stiffly backward, as in opisthotonos.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Æth.]
Axillary glands swollen.
Sensation as if arms had become much shorter.
Numbness of arms.
Aching about scapulæ, extending to arms.
Thumb and fingers bent inward. θ Convulsions of children.
